name: Takanashi Yumina
source:
[url=/c1561]Yuuri’s[/url] non-blood-related sister. She used to live together with Yuuri and his father but lives with someone else now for reasons unknown. Yumina is really shy and sometimes fails in what she does. Kind of a crybaby. She idolises [url=/c1564]Mifuyu[/url] completely and is also a florence student.

[From [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/03/29/%E3%82%BF%E3%83%A6%E3%82%BF%E3%83%9E-kiss-on-my-deity-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
